title: Constitutional Design
subtitle: Understanding the Framework of Indian Democracy
subject: Social Science
author: Shine Academy Naroda
learning_outcomes: Understand the meaning and importance of a Constitution.
Learn about the framing of the Indian Constitution.
Understand the key features and philosophy of the Indian Constitution.
Appreciate the role of the Constituent Assembly.

ai_context.learning_goal: To master the concepts of constitutional design, specifically the historical context, formation, and key features of the Indian Constitution.
common_misconceptions: The Constitution was written by a single person.
Constitutional laws are just suggestions, not binding rules.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student struggles with the concept of the Constituent Assembly, ask them to imagine creating rules for a new game with all their friends, highlighting the need for consensus.
